allOf.description: WI-386: conditional blueprints. changeset_blueprints is the EXECUTOR contract — full CREATE payloads + MODIFY diffs a zero-context subagent (DISPATCH=mimo-pro|sonnet) reads instead of the spec. When the orchestrator executes INLINE with full context already loaded (the only mode used in practice per .svc/dispatch-log.jsonl), authoring blueprints is Opus-priced double-spend (WI-347 authored code at PLAN prices, execute-changeset re-applied it at EXEC). The if/then/else below keeps blueprints HARD-REQUIRED for the dispatch path and FAIL-CLOSED for any receipt that does not explicitly self-declare mode:inline — preserving WI-347's zero-context isolation guarantee. The `if` requires mode PRESENT and == inline (a bare `properties` constraint is vacuously true when the key is absent, which would fail OPEN — the classic draft-07 trap); only then does the exemption apply, otherwise `else` re-imposes the requirement. The chain's enforcement engine (scripts/check-chain-receipts.mjs) mirrors this gate because that custom validator, not a generic JSON-Schema library, is what runs on every commit/push.

mode.description: WI-386: the execution mode resolved BEFORE planning. 'dispatch' = a zero-context executor (DISPATCH=mimo-pro|sonnet) will build from the contract → changeset_blueprints REQUIRED (full payloads, the executor's only source of truth). 'inline' = the orchestrator executes with full context already loaded → blueprints may be omitted (the redundant transcription WI-386 removes). ABSENT defaults to dispatch semantics (fail-closed): an unmarked receipt must still carry blueprints, so legacy v1/v2 manifests and any forgery that omits the field keep WI-347's hard requirement. Mirrors .svc/dispatch-log.jsonl's new `mode` field.

lane.description: WI-383: the delivery lane (greenfield|brownfield-*|bugfix|drift|refactor|framework) so mine-receipts can bucket gate telemetry per-lane. Optional; untagged receipts bucket as 'unknown' (which never earns compression — safe).

ac_digests.description: WI-381 pipeline baton: a NAVIGATION index of the spec's acceptance criteria so downstream chain skills read the baton FIRST instead of re-reading the full spec. NOT authoritative — the live spec at spec_path remains the sole AC source. spec_ac_table_sha256 hash-binds the digests to the spec's normalized AC signatures (scripts/lib/normalize-ac-table.mjs) so a mid-pipeline AC REVISION fails the binding and forces a re-distill; it is insensitive to checkbox/progress flips and verification annotations. Listed in `required` per WI-381 AC4 but ENFORCED only for schema_version>=3 by the chain's custom validators (check-chain-receipts.mjs / emit-receipt.mjs) — legacy v1/v2 plan-manifests are grandfathered, mirroring the WI-396 diff_hash version gate. The chain does not run a standard JSON-Schema validator over these receipts.

spec_path.description: Repo-relative path of the authoritative spec the digests index.

spec_ac_table_sha256.description: sha256 over the normalized AC signatures of spec_path (acTableSha256). Recomputed by validators.

entries.description: Per-AC navigation digests. May be empty when a spec has no parseable AC rows; the hash still binds.

ac_id.description: AC identifier (e.g. PF-01) or ordinal for checklist ACs.

digest.description: One-line distilled requirement — attention router, not the authoritative text.

anchor.description: Optional file:line pointer into the live spec.

mocked_deps.description: WI-381 baton: dependencies the plan mocks/stubs, so downstream skills know what is faked without re-reading the manifest blueprints. Optional (omit or [] when nothing is mocked).

dep.description: The dependency being mocked (module, provider, endpoint, fixture).

reason.description: Why it is mocked for this changeset.

mock_location.description: Optional path where the mock/stub lives.
